pricing_text: Planned pricing per output image is **$0.008 at 768 × 768**, **$0.009 at 1K**, **$0.011 at 1.5K**, **$0.014 at 2K**, and **$0.036 at 4K**. The same planned rates apply to generation and editing; for example, **10 images at 1K would cost $0.09**. Final pricing is not yet confirmed.
notes: النص يقول صراحة إن التسعير "مخطط" وغير مؤكد نهائيًا (Final pricing is not yet confirmed) — لذا الثقة متوسطة. usd للافتراضي (square_hd ≈ 1K = $0.009)؛ الأرخص 768×768 = $0.008. الدقة تُحدَّد عبر image_size (256–4096 لكل ضلع). num_images حتى 4.
